g.text: HW_KILL_N: local 3.3 V open-drain/contact-to-ground boundary only; no harness/12 V direct connection.

g.desc: HW_KILL_N: local 3.3 V open-drain/contact-to-ground boundary only; no harness/12 V direct connection.

g.text: No independent max-dwell/current limiter exists yet. ARM timing and power-sequence fault injection remain required.

g.desc: No independent max-dwell/current limiter exists yet. ARM timing and power-sequence fault injection remain required.

g.text: IC decoupling capacitors C801..C805 must be placed at U801..U805 respectively.

g.desc: IC decoupling capacitors C801..C805 must be placed at U801..U805 respectively.

g.text: 3.3 V logic only. Hardware faults asynchronously clear enable; recovery requires a fresh ARM rising edge.

g.desc: 3.3 V logic only. Hardware faults asynchronously clear enable; recovery requires a fresh ARM rising edge.

g.text: MIC output isolation remains DNP. No PT2001 DRVEN connection or assumed polarity.
